history.roll_here_hint: Put the roll-back marker in front of this feature: it and the features after it are not rebuilt.
history.suppress_hint: Untick to suppress the feature (it is skipped in the replay)

sketch.hint.angle: Click two lines, then type the angle in degrees. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.arc3: Click the start, the end, then a point on the arc. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.arc_centre: Click the centre, the start, then the end direction (counter-clockwise). Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.circle: Click the centre, then a point on the circle. Type a number and press Enter for an exact radius. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.dimension: Click a line (length), an arc or circle (radius) or two points (distance), then type the value. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.line: Click the start, then the end. Type a number and press Enter for an exact length. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.one: Click a line (or a point for Fix). Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.polyline: Click the points; Enter, right click or a click on the last point ends; a click on the first point closes. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.rect: Click two opposite corners. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.select: Drag a point to move it. Double-click a dimension to edit its value. Esc: cancel.
sketch.hint.tangent: Click a line and an arc or circle. Esc: cancel.
sketch.notice.arc_degenerate: those points do not make an arc
sketch.notice.value: enter a valid number (lengths and radii must be positive)
sketch.title: Sketch: {name}

tool.brep_hint: Click a face or edge of a body; Shift toggles. Picked faces and edges fill the faces / edges parameters of commands.
tool.brush_hint: Drag to paint triangles, Shift+drag to erase, Alt+drag to orbit.
tool.gizmo_hint: Drag an axis handle; Esc cancels. One undo step per drag.
tool.gizmo_no_mesh: Select a scan in the object tree to move it.
tool.lasso_hint: Draw an outline around triangles; Shift adds, {cmd} removes.
stage.scan.hint: Bring a scan in and clean it up: remove spikes, loose pieces and holes.
stage.align.hint: Put the scan straight on the X, Y and Z axes, so everything after it is measured from the right place.
stage.segment.hint: Split the scan into regions: flat faces, cylinders, freeform areas.
stage.shapes.hint: Fit planes, cylinders, spheres and cones to regions, and cut sections through the scan.
stage.sketch.hint: Draw 2D profiles on a plane, or trace them from a section of the scan.
stage.solid.hint: Turn sketches and regions into a solid: extrude, revolve, round the edges.
stage.surface.hint: Cover the freeform areas of the scan with smooth surfaces.
stage.inspect.hint: Compare the model with the scan and see where they differ.
stage.export.hint: Save the result as STEP or IGES for a CAD program, or as a mesh.
guide.title: From scan to CAD
guide.intro: Follow the steps in order. Click a step to open its tools.
guide.finished: All steps are done. Keep refining the model, or export it again.
guide.import.hint: Start with a mesh from your 3D scanner (STL, OBJ, PLY), or try the sample part.
guide.clean.hint: Remove spikes and loose pieces and close small holes, so the next steps work on a tidy mesh.
guide.align.hint: A scan arrives at a random angle. Align the part so its main faces lie on the X, Y and Z planes.
guide.segment.hint: Auto segment finds the faces of the part. Each region becomes one face of the model.
guide.model.hint: Make a solid from the regions or from sketches. Shapes, Sketch and Surface help where the part needs them.
guide.check.hint: A deviation map colours the model by its distance from the scan.
guide.export.hint: Select the body or surface in the object list and save it as STEP for your CAD program.
ribbon.search_more: and {n} more: type more to narrow down
ribbon.more.hint: The other tools of this stage.
ribbon.new_sketch.hint: Start a sketch on one of the world planes.
ribbon.edit_sketch.hint: Draw in the sketch selected in the object list. Select a sketch first.
ribbon.finish_sketch.hint: Leave the sketch and return to the 3D view.
action.sample_scan.hint: Loads a small synthetic scan of a bracket, so you can try the tools without a scanner.
action.search_tools.hint: Find any tool by its name ({cmd}+K).
action.show_guide.hint: Close the open tool and show the steps from scan to CAD.
action.toggle_log.hint: Show or hide the log of commands as a script would send them.
action.save.hint: Save the project to a file.
action.import_mesh.hint: Load a scan from an STL, OBJ, PLY or point file.
action.import_step.hint: Load a CAD model from a STEP file.
action.export_step.hint: Save the selected body or surface as STEP. Select one in the object list first.
action.export_mesh.hint: Save the selected scan as STL, OBJ or PLY. Select a scan in the object list first.
action.fit_all.hint: Zoom so that everything is in view.
action.reset_layout.hint: Put the panels back where they started.

welcome.title: Turn a 3D scan into a CAD model
welcome.intro: Bring in a scan to begin. The guide on the right shows the next step at every stage.
welcome.steps: Scan · Align · Segment · Model · Inspect · Export
welcome.mouse: Left drag orbits, right drag pans, the wheel zooms.
param.name: Name
cmd.align.center.hint: Moves the scan so its middle sits at the origin.
cmd.align.auto.hint: Finds a good position for a fresh scan by itself: it lies on its largest flat face, long side along X. Shows a proposal first.
cmd.align.symmetry.hint: Puts the part's mirror plane on a main plane of the world. Shows a proposal first.
cmd.align.datum.hint: Aligns by a plane, an axis and a point that you pick on the scan.
cmd.align.icp.hint: Nudges the scan onto another object for the closest possible match.
cmd.align.n_point.hint: Moves the scan so the points you pick land on the coordinates you give.
cmd.align.principal.hint: Turns the scan so its longest directions follow the X, Y and Z axes. A good first try.
cmd.body.from_regions.hint: Builds a solid straight from the fitted regions of the scan.
cmd.deviation.at.hint: Reads the deviation of one scan triangle from its map.
cmd.deviation.compute.hint: Colours an object by its distance from the scan.
cmd.deviation.hotspots.hint: Lists the places where the model is furthest from the scan.
cmd.deviation.noise.hint: Measures how rough the scan is, to choose a sensible tolerance.
cmd.deviation.stats.hint: Shows the average and the largest deviation in numbers.
cmd.scan.qa.hint: Lists what to clean in a scan first: holes, debris, bad triangles and noise.
cmd.scan.to_solid.hint: Turns a scan into a closed solid in one step and measures it against the scan.
cmd.mesh.import_stream.hint: Loads a very large scan from disk piece by piece into a folder, without filling the memory.
cmd.mesh.store_info.hint: Shows the size and the accuracy levels of a large scan stored in a folder, and can check it for damage.
cmd.body.compare.hint: Shows, face by face, how far the body is from the scan.
cmd.deviation.to_primitive.hint: Measures how far a region is from its fitted shape.
cmd.export.iges.hint: Saves bodies and surfaces as an IGES file.
cmd.export.section_sheet.hint: Saves section outlines as a drawing sheet.
cmd.feature.boolean.hint: Joins two solids, cuts one from the other, or keeps what they share.
cmd.feature.draft.hint: Tilts faces by an angle, as on moulded parts.
cmd.feature.extrude.hint: Pulls a closed sketch profile straight out into a solid.
cmd.feature.loft.hint: Blends between two or more profiles.
cmd.feature.mirror.hint: Copies a solid to the other side of a plane.
cmd.feature.pattern.hint: Repeats a feature in a row or around an axis.
cmd.feature.revolve.hint: Spins a sketch profile around an axis into a solid.
cmd.feature.shell.hint: Hollows a solid, leaving walls of a set thickness.
cmd.feature.sweep.hint: Moves a profile along a path to make a solid.
cmd.mesh.clean.hint: Removes duplicate points, bad triangles and tiny loose specks in one go.
cmd.mesh.decimate.hint: Reduces the number of triangles, so the scan is lighter to work with.
cmd.mesh.fill_holes.hint: Closes holes in the scan with new triangles.
cmd.mesh.working_begin.hint: Makes an editable copy of the scan next to the original. Edits act on the copy and the original stays as it is.
cmd.mesh.working_distance.hint: Measures how far the working copy is from the original: largest, average and percentiles.
cmd.mesh.working_promote.hint: The working copy becomes the scan; regions and layouts built on the old triangles are removed.
cmd.mesh.working_discard.hint: Removes the working copy and keeps the original as it is.
cmd.mesh.remove_outliers.hint: Deletes points that stick far out of the surface (scanner noise).
cmd.mesh.remove_small.hint: Deletes small islands that are not connected to the main part.
cmd.mesh.smooth.hint: Evens out scanner noise while keeping the overall shape.
cmd.primitive.auto_constrain.hint: Squares up fitted shapes: nearly parallel and nearly perpendicular ones become exact.
cmd.primitive.fit.hint: Fits a plane, cylinder, sphere, cone or torus to a region.
cmd.primitive.symmetry.hint: Finds the plane the scan is mirrored about.
cmd.primitive.trim_to_region.hint: Cuts a fitted shape back to the outline of its region.
cmd.quad.create.hint: Lays a grid of four-sided patches over the scan to control how the surface flows.
cmd.quad.retopo.hint: Rebuilds the scan as a clean mesh of four-sided faces.
cmd.region.auto_segment.hint: Splits the whole scan into regions along its sharp edges.
cmd.region.create.hint: Makes a region from the triangles you selected with the brush or the lasso.
cmd.region.enlarge.hint: Widens a region by a ring of neighbouring triangles.
cmd.region.grow.hint: Extends a region from a clicked triangle over the smooth area around it.
cmd.region.shrink.hint: Pulls the border of a region in by a ring of triangles.
cmd.section.stack.hint: Cuts the scan with a row of parallel planes and keeps the outlines.
cmd.sketch.fit_chains.hint: Replaces a traced outline with clean lines and arcs.
cmd.sketch.from_section.hint: Cuts the scan with a plane and puts the outline in a sketch.
cmd.surface.auto.hint: Covers the whole scan with surface patches automatically.
cmd.surface.fit.hint: Fits a smooth surface to a region of the scan.
cmd.surface.from_curves.hint: Builds surface patches between feature curves.
cmd.surface.thicken.hint: Gives a surface a thickness, turning it into a solid.
cmd.surface.trim_to_region.hint: Cuts a surface back to the outline of its region.
cmd.body.box.hint: Makes a box of the size you give.
cmd.body.cylinder.hint: Makes a cylinder of the radius and height you give.
cmd.body.sphere.hint: Makes a sphere of the radius you give.
cmd.body.chamfer.hint: Cuts the picked edges of a body at an angle. Not kept in the feature history.
cmd.body.fillet.hint: Rounds the picked edges of a body. Not kept in the feature history.
cmd.body.extract_face.hint: Copies one face of a body as a separate surface.
cmd.body.info.hint: Shows the number of faces and edges and the volume of a body.
cmd.body.plan_regions.hint: Shows how each fitted region would be used to build the solid, before you build it.
cmd.body.refit_faces.hint: Moves the faces of a body a little so they match the scan more closely.
cmd.body.refit_features.hint: Adjusts the dimensions in the feature history so the body matches the scan more closely.
cmd.body.replace_face.hint: Swaps a flat face of a body for a freeform surface.
cmd.body.to_mesh.hint: Turns a body into a triangle mesh.
cmd.export.step.hint: Saves bodies and surfaces as a STEP file at the path you type.
cmd.feature.edit.hint: Changes the values of a feature and rebuilds the model.
cmd.feature.path_pattern.hint: Repeats a body evenly along a sketched path.
cmd.feature.replay.hint: Rebuilds every body from the feature history.
cmd.feature.split.hint: Cuts a body with a plane and keeps one side.
cmd.feature.suggest_axis.hint: Reads the axis of a turned region of the scan, ready to use in Revolve.
cmd.feature.suggest_draft.hint: Measures the draft angle of a side face on the scan, ready to use in Draft.
cmd.feature.suggest_fillet.hint: Measures the radius of a rounded edge on the scan, ready to use in Fillet.
cmd.feature.suppress.hint: Switches a feature off or back on and rebuilds the model.
cmd.feature.rollback.hint: Moves the roll-back marker: the features after it are not rebuilt, so the body is as it was at that step.
cmd.sketch.move_point.hint: Moves a sketch point; the constraints move the rest of the sketch with it.
cmd.feature.tree.hint: Lists the features with what they depend on and any errors.
cmd.import.step.hint: Loads the bodies of a STEP file from the path you type.
cmd.mesh.export.hint: Saves a scan as STL, OBJ or PLY at the path you type.
cmd.mesh.import.hint: Loads a scan from the path you type. A point cloud is turned into a mesh.
cmd.mesh.info.hint: Shows the number of triangles, the size and the area of a scan.
cmd.mesh.reconstruct.hint: Builds a mesh from a cloud of points.
cmd.mesh.synth.hint: Makes an artificial scan of a simple shape, to try the tools on.
cmd.mesh.transform.hint: Moves or turns a scan by exact values.
cmd.mesh.scale_from_length.hint: Brings a scan of unknown size (photogrammetry) to true size: you give two points on it and the real distance between them.
cmd.primitive.info.hint: Shows the dimensions of a fitted shape and how well it fits.
cmd.quad.crease.hint: Marks lines of the quad layout where the surface keeps a sharp edge.
cmd.quad.merge.hint: Makes the quad layout coarser: every 2 by 2 quads become one.
cmd.quad.snap.hint: Pulls the corners of the quad layout onto the scan.
cmd.quad.split.hint: Makes the quad layout finer: every quad becomes four.
cmd.region.insert.hint: Makes a region from triangles, or from everything inside a sphere or a box.
cmd.region.list.hint: Lists the regions of a scan.
cmd.region.resegment.hint: Segments the chosen regions again and leaves the others as they are.
cmd.region.separate.hint: Splits a region into its separate connected pieces.
cmd.sketch.add.hint: Adds lines, arcs, circles or polygons to a sketch by coordinates. Drawing with the mouse is easier: use Edit sketch.
cmd.sketch.constrain.hint: Adds constraints to a sketch by entity numbers. With the mouse it is easier: use Edit sketch.
cmd.sketch.create.hint: Makes an empty sketch on a plane without opening it.
cmd.sketch.edit_constraint.hint: Changes or removes one constraint of a sketch.
cmd.sketch.solve.hint: Solves the constraints of a sketch again and rebuilds what depends on it.
cmd.surface.info.hint: Shows the control net, the degree and the deviation of a surface.
busy.hint: The view shows the document from before this command.
busy.cancel_hint: Stop waiting for this command and keep the document as it was
busy.in_place: This browser page has no background threads, so the page will not respond until the command has finished.
status.finishing: The cancelled command is still finishing; try again in a moment
cmd.surface.wrap.hint: Covers the whole scan with a watertight network of patches fitted to it; for castings, body panels and organic shapes.
